instruction: List all VMs with power state
output: az vm list --query "[?powerState=='VM running'].{Name:name, RG:resourceGroup}" -o table
az vm list --query "[?powerState=='VM running'].{Name:name, RG:resourceGroup}" -o table
az vm stop --name myVM --resource-group myResourceGroup
az storage container create --name mycontainer --account-name mystorageaccount
az account set --subscription my-subscription-id
az vm show --name myVM --resource-group myResourceGroup --query '{Name:name,OS:storageProfile.osDisk.osType,Size:hardwareProfile.vmSize}' -o table
az storage blob upload --container-name mycontainer --name myblob --file myfile.txt --account-name mystorageaccount
az aks scale --resource-group myResourceGroup --name myAKSCluster --node-count 5
az webapp create --name myWebApp --resource-group myResourceGroup --plan myPlan --runtime 'PYTHON:3.9'
az group delete --name myResourceGroup --yes --no-wait
az role assignment create --assignee user@example.com --role Contributor --resource-group myResourceGroup
az vm create --name myVM --resource-group myResourceGroup --image Ubuntu2204 --admin-username azureuser --generate-ssh-keys
az ad user list --query '[].{DisplayName:displayName,UPN:userPrincipalName}' -o table
az webapp list --resource-group myResourceGroup --query '[].{Name:name,State:state,URL:defaultHostName}' -o table
az webapp log tail --resource-group myResourceGroup --name myWebApp
az storage blob list --container-name mycontainer --account-name mystorageaccount --query '[].{Name:name,Size:properties.contentLength}' -o table
az network public-ip create --resource-group myResourceGroup --name myPublicIP --allocation-method Static
az storage account create --name mystorageaccount --resource-group myResourceGroup --location eastus --sku Standard_LRS
az aks update --resource-group myResourceGroup --name myAKSCluster --enable-cluster-autoscaler --min-count 1 --max-count 10
az network nsg rule create --resource-group myResourceGroup --nsg-name myNSG --name AllowSSH --protocol tcp --priority 1000 --destination-port-ranges 22 --access Allow
az aks get-credentials --resource-group myResourceGroup --name myAKSCluster
az acr create --resource-group myResourceGroup --name myRegistry --sku Basic
az functionapp create --name myFunctionApp --resource-group myResourceGroup --storage-account mystorageaccount --consumption-plan-location eastus --runtime python
az group list --query '[].{Name:name,Location:location}' -o table
az vm disk attach --resource-group myResourceGroup --vm-name myVM --name myDisk --size-gb 50 --new
az vm list-sizes --location eastus --query '[].{Name:name,CPUs:numberOfCores,Memory:memoryInMb}' -o table
